newsitem.title: USA: GlenFed to open offices in Kinko's.
newsitem.headline: GlenFed to open offices in Kinko's.

text.p: Glendale Federal Bank and Kinko's Inc said it signed an agreement whereby Glendale Federal will open banking offices inside selected Kinko's locations in California.

"By establishing banking offices in Kinko's locations, we can provide these customers with 24-hour access to Glendale Federal's business and consumer banking products and services," said Stephen Trafton, chairman and chief executive officer of Glendale Federal.
Kinko's is a chain of photocopying stores.
The agreement provides for an initial test phase during which Glendale Federal will have the option of leasing space in up to 20 Kinko's stores in California.
